pageProps.review: A coffee shop inside the Queen Victoria Building (QVB). Ordered the signature White Rabbit latte and a Long Black. The latte was topped with orange zest and had a clean, smooth finish overall.
pageProps.content: ## Review A coffee shop inside the Queen Victoria Building (QVB). Ordered the signature White Rabbit latte and a Long Black. The latte was topped with orange zest and had a clean, smooth finish overall. Honestly, I'm not sure whether it was exceptionally good. That said, QVB is somewhere you'll likely end up visiting in Sydney, and grabbing a coffee there for a break isn't a bad choice at all. ## Pictures
